result.instructions: Tools for GivingFuel, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much did we raise in the last 30 days, and from which forms?"; "List the recurring gifts that are due to run in the next week."; "Show all donations from jane@example.com.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes GivingFuel data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run givingfuel_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run givingfuel_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run givingfuel_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. givingfuel_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: givingfuel_list_forms
tools.title: List donation forms
tools.description: List the account's GivingFuel forms (donation / fundraising pages): id, name, status (open or closed), created and updated dates. Use the form ids to filter orders, transactions and subscriptions. GET /forms.

created_after.description: Only records created after this time.

created_before.description: Only records created before this time.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time.

updated_before.description: Only records updated before this time.

starting_after.description: Cursor: pass the previous reply's next_starting_after to get the next page.

sort.description: Sort by id: asc or desc (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: givingfuel_get_form
tools.title: Get donation form
tools.description: One form by id: name, status, accounting reference, time zone and its field layout. GET /forms/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_form_inventory
tools.title: Get form inventory
tools.description: Inventory items of a form (limited-quantity items): path, name, sold and remaining quantity. GET /forms/{id}/inventory.

tools.name: givingfuel_list_orders
tools.title: List donation orders
tools.description: List donation orders (one per checkout): order number, donor billing name and address, form, total, currency and status, newest or oldest first. Filter by form, status, donor email, customer id, order number or dates. GET /search/orders.

status.description: Order status string as the vendor returns it (for example "completed" or "active").

email.description: Only orders placed with this email address.

customer_id.description: Only orders of this customer (donor) id.

order_number.description: Only the order with this order number.

updated_before.description: Only records updated before this time.

sort.description: Sort by id: asc or desc (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: givingfuel_get_order
tools.title: Get donation order
tools.description: One order by id with the donor's billing details, form, totals and status. Set include_transactions to embed the payments (charges and refunds) of the order. GET /search/orders/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_list_transactions
tools.title: List transactions
tools.description: List payment transactions (money movements): amount, deductible amount, currency, type (charge, refund, voucher), payment method, masked card, status, form and donor email. Filter by type, method, form, order, donor or dates. GET /search/transactions.

status.description: Transaction status string as the vendor returns it (for example "completed" or "active").

order_id.description: Only transactions of this order id.

customer_id.description: Only transactions of this customer (donor) id.

email.description: Only transactions of orders placed with this email.

order_number.description: Only transactions of this order number.

reference.description: Only the transaction with this payment reference (txReference).

created_before.description: Only records created before this time.

updated_after.description: Only records updated after this time.

updated_before.description: Only records updated before this time.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_transaction
tools.title: Get transaction
tools.description: One transaction by id: amounts, type, payment method, masked card, gateway message and status. GET /search/transactions/{id}.

order_id.description: Only subscriptions of this order id.

customer_id.description: Only subscriptions of this customer (donor) id.

email.description: Only subscriptions of orders placed with this email.

next_payment_after.description: Only subscriptions scheduled to run after this time.

last_payment_after.description: Only subscriptions last processed after this time.

tools.name: givingfuel_get_customer

tools.description: One donor (customer record) by id: email, billing details and total amount. GET /search/customers/{id}.

customer_id.description: GivingFuel customer id (from givingfuel_list_customers, or an order's customerId).

tools.name: givingfuel_list_coupons
tools.title: List coupons
tools.description: List GivingFuel coupons: account-wide ones, or only those of one form when form_id is given. Shows discounts, codes, availability, redeemed count and expiry. GET /coupons/global or /coupons/forms/{id}.

form_id.description: Only coupons of this form; omit for the account-wide (global) coupons.

code.description: Only global coupons with this code (ignored with form_id).

starting_after.description: Cursor: pass the previous reply's next_starting_after to get the next page.

sort.description: Sort by id: asc or desc (the vendor default applies when omitted).

tools.name: givingfuel_get_coupon
tools.title: Get coupon
tools.description: One coupon by id with its discounts, codes, availability and redeemed counts. GET /coupons/{id}.

tools.name: givingfuel_create_coupon
tools.title: Create coupon
tools.description: WRITE: create a discount coupon in the live GivingFuel account (it can be redeemed by donors right away). One discount (fixed amount or percent) and one or more codes; optionally limited to one form, to a number of uses, and to an expiry date. Not idempotent: calling it twice creates two coupons. POST /coupons.

discount_value.description: Discount amount: currency units for a fixed discount, percent (1-100) for a percent discount.

available.description: How many times the coupon can be used; -1 = unlimited (default).

form_id.description: Restrict the coupon to this form; omit for all forms.

expires.description: When the coupon expires; omit for no expiry.

tools.name: givingfuel_delete_coupon
tools.title: Delete coupon
tools.description: WRITE: permanently delete a coupon from the live GivingFuel account; its codes stop working immediately and this cannot be undone. Show the coupon (givingfuel_get_coupon) and get the user's approval first, then call with confirm: true. GET /coupons/{id}, then DELETE /coupons/{id}.

confirm.description: Must be true: the user approved permanently deleting this coupon.
